newsitem.title: CHINA: China firecracker factory blast kills 13 children.
newsitem.headline: China firecracker factory blast kills 13 children.

text.p: An explosion at a firecracker factory in central China last week killed 13 children and injured 19, an official said on Wednesday.
"All the dead and injured people were seven- to 14-year-old children," a government official in Linquan county in Anhui province said by telephone.
The official declined to say what caused the October 20 explosion.
The factory in Linquan county had operated without a business licence and had been illegally using children as workers, he said.

"It didn't have the necessary safety measures and also broke the labour law by hiring child labourers," he said but declined to give further details or say if the casualties were workers in the plant.

Fireworks, considered essential for traditional Chinese festivals and celebrations, are blamed for killing or injuring 60,000 people a year, with many of the casualties caused by accidents during production or transport.
China has banned construction of new firecracker plants and has ordered severe punishment for anyone who makes, sells, stores or transports fireworks illegally.
